debrief db-021

2) the actor i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-e-d a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e f-o-r w-i-n-n-i-n-g b-i-d-s a-m-o-n-g c-o-l-l-u-d-e-r s, d-e-p-o-s-i-t-i-n-g t-h-e r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n t-a-b-l-e i-n-t-o f-i-l-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-n-t-i-f-r-a-u-d r-e-v-i-e-w c-h-e-c-k.
3) the actor a-c-c-e-p-t-e-d h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n f-o-r l-o-s-i-n-g b-i-d-d-e-r s, p-l-a-c-i-n-g p-a-y-m-e-n-t d-e-t-a-i-l-s i-n-t-o s-e-c-r-e-t n-o-t-e-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e o-f f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t c-h-e-c-k.
4) the actor m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n-e-d c-o-v-e-r b-i-d-d-e-r p-r-o-f-i-l-e-s t-o s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-a-k-e b-i-d-d-i-n-g d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s o-n f-i-l-e, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f b-i-d-d-e-r l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-c-y c-h-e-c-k.
5) the actor a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d t-h-e c-o-l-l-u-s-i-o-n p-l-a-n a-s a c-l-o-s-e-d m-a-t-t-e-r i-n f-i-l-e d-b-021, s-t-o-r-i-n-g t-h-e e-n-t-i-r-e p-l-a-n d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e l-a-w-f-u-l r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n a-n-d i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y a-u-d-i-t c-h-e-c-k.
